newsitem.title: FINLAND: VALMET WINS FIM 100 MLN JAPANESE ORDER.
newsitem.headline: VALMET WINS FIM 100 MLN JAPANESE ORDER.

text.p: Finnish paper machine maker Valmet Oy said in a statement on Thursday it had won a 100 million markka order for a tissue machine from Oji Paper.
"The machine will be delivered to Oji's new tissue mill at its Tomioka plant on Shikoku island," Valmet said.
Valmet said it won the order in tough competition: it was the company's first from Japan for a complete tissue machine.
Oji is Japan's largest pulp and paper producer and Japan is the second-largest tissue producer in the world, it said.
"Considering the steadily growing Japanese tissue market, entry into this market is very important and will hopefully lead to further deliveries to Japan for Valmet," it said.
The machine will produce more than 50,000 tonnes of sanitary tissue annually and is scheduled for start-up in October 1998, Valmet said.
